PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
AI researcher and engineer specializing in LLMs, low-resource NLP, multimodal AI, and computer vision. Author of 2 published
papers and 3 under review, with hands-on experience in RAG, LLM fine-tuning, vision-language systems, and end-to-end AI
development. Skilled in PyTorch, Hugging Face, QLoRA/LoRA, LangChain, YOLO, and FastAPI. Solved 260+ problems across
LeetCode, Codeforces, and other competitive programming platforms.
EXPERIENCE
Undergraduate Researcher
Jan 2023 – June 2026
United International University
- Built and released 2 Bangla NLP datasets and benchmarked 10+ LLMs using QLoRA and 4-bit quantization.
- Developed Cultural Chain-of-Thought methods and a YOLO + vision-language framework and published at CVPR Workshop.

PUBLICATIONS
When a Name Is Not a Name: A Benchmark Dataset and Distilled Reasoning for Culturally Entangled Bangla
Homographs in Low-Resource LLMs
Built a 1,516-sentence Bangla benchmark dataset HuggingFace and evaluated open-source LLMs with zero/few-shot and Cultural
Chain-of-Thought prompting. Fine-tuned 1–3B models using QLoRA for distilled cultural reasoning · Under Review
Polite on the Surface, Broken in Practice: A Curated Dataset for Fixing Generation and Register Failures in
Low-Resource Bangla Text Generation
Developed an instruction-tuning dataset of 4,196 samples to benchmark Bangla LLM generation. Fine-tuned Open-source LLM
models using LoRA and 4-bit NormalFloat quantization.Under Review.
VisText-Mosquito: A Unified Multimodal Dataset for Visual Detection, and Textual Explanation on Mosquito
Breeding Sites
Developed a multimodal dataset and framework combining object detection, segmentation, and vision-language models for automated
mosquito breeding-site analysis.Published
